svg.data-depth-with-handles: 518.9 mm over fan and power-supply handles (Table 19; drawing g009881 reads 518.4)
svg.data-psu-ac-input: dedicated feed per inlet; breaker min 20 A at 110 VAC or 16 A at 220 VAC
svg.data-psu-dc-input: PS0 from feed A, PS1 from feed B (A/B redundancy)
svg.data-max-thermal-output: 1705 BTU/hour (500 W) (Table 20; provisioning ceiling, not reconciled with the 280 W maximum draw)
svg.data-operating-temp: 0 C to 40 C normal; -5 C to 55 C short-term (NEBS GR-63-CORE Issue 4 short-term, up to 96 h, max 15 days/year)
svg.data-storage-temp: -40 C to 70 C in shipping container
svg.data-storage: 100-GB SATA SSD (Routing Engine description; the faceplate carries SSD0 and SSD1 activity LEDs, and no sentence in the guide states the drive count)
svg.data-routing-engine: built-in on the baseboard, not replaceable
svg.data-rate-selectability: each QSFP port runs 100GbE, 40GbE, or 4x10GbE via breakout; QSA adapter (MAM1Q00A-QSA) converts a port to single 10GbE or 1GbE from Junos 18.3R1
svg.data-timing: BITS and ToD RJ45 ports, 1PPS and 10 MHz SMB input and output, PTP grandmaster clock SFP port (GM/PTP)
svg.data-oob: MGMT RJ-45, autosensing 10/100/1000 with link and activity LEDs
svg.data-usb: single USB port (guide names no revision)
svg.data-seismic: Designed to meet Telcordia Technologies Zone 4 earthquake requirements (Table 20 wording, transcribed)
